subject: Post-demo: DPA intake + SCC module recommendation and next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@lumenpay.com>, LumenPay Security <security@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: DPA intake + SCC module recommendation and next steps

Hi Rajesh / LumenPay security team — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and recommended path for the GDPR/DPA and SCC decision so we can keep the procurement timeline tight.

Call summary (high level)
- You confirmed LumenPay will be the data controller for customer PII and Redwood would be a processor for payment support flows (exceptions for some analytics where you asked about co-processing).
- Primary compliance asks: DPA with standard SCC modules, SOC 2 Type II evidence, and optional HIPAA scoping for payment metadata (you said legal will confirm).
- Timeline: procurement hopes to complete contracting by end of June; security review in parallel.

Recommended immediate actions (my suggested order)
1) Please complete the attached DPA intake form (short) so we capture controller/processor confirmations and any retention/email-security constraints — target: Rajesh by Tue 5/25.
2) SCC module recommendation: we recommend Standard Module 2 (Controller-Processor) + Module 4 where joint processing applies. See the attached SCC_Module_Options.xlsx for a quick mapping to your described flows. If LumenPay prefers Redwood to be Controller for analytics, we can discuss Module 1 variants.
3) SOC 2 evidence: Redwood will share our latest SOC 2 Type II summary and test report. Ben, looping you to attach the report and a short evidence index for the security questionnaire.
4) Vendor questionnaire kickoff: If your security team wants to start the CVSS-style questionnaire, share the target owner and an expected due date — we can return completed answers within 3 business days for the standard 120 Q set.

Ask from you now
- Rajesh: confirm who on your side will sign the DPA and provide the intake form back (name + email).
- Security team: are you expecting Redwood to propose a Module selection or do you want procurement/legal to request a specific mapping?

Next call: propose a 30-min alignment with Legal and Procurement next week (Tue or Wed morning PT).

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: LumenPay_DPA_Request_Form.pdf (fillable form), SCC_Module_Options.xlsx (module mapping)
From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@lumenpay.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: DPA intake + SCC module recommendation and next steps

Thanks Irene — good demo. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Controller/Processor: Our legal lead (Anya Patel) will be the DPA signatory; she prefers us to draft the initial DPA with our preferred modules. That said, we want Redwood's recommendation included.
2) SCC modules: We like the Module 2 suggestion since Redwood will process transaction support data; for analytics (aggregated insights) legal will confirm if they want joint-controller language.
3) SOC 2: we need the full SOC 2 Type II report (not just the summary) for higher-risk data flows. Can you confirm turnaround?
4) HIPAA: This is currently low priority but we might surface it depending on regulator feedback — will flag later.

I'll put Anya on the thread and ask procurement to complete the intake form by 5/25. If Redwood can send the SOC 2 report and a quick answers pack for common vendor questionnaire items by EOD tomorrow that would be great.

— Rajesh
